inheritance.rationale: OrcaRouter reports identical Contributor/standard checkpoints; LLM Stats describes Contributor as a pricing/data-use tier. models.dev opencode entry explicitly lists this free route, zero input/output prices, text output and xhigh effort. This is a cross-route estimate, not a measured Zen result. models.dev does NOT advertise max for this route. Meta primary pricing docs (read 2026-09-26) list muse-spark-1.3 in both Standard and Contributor tiers, differing only in price and training-data use; effort parity is not stated there. Capabilities re-confirmed 2026-09-26 in fresh models.dev snapshot ($0 in/out, text-out, xhigh, not deprecated).
